card.name: Inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside long stretches of ALL-CAPS text, such as boxed warnings or shouted sentences. Often a short linking word like OR, ON, WE, or a period or word ending inside the caps.

modes.label: Caps warning text

modes.label: Caps in web prose
modes.description: Words or word endings in all-caps headings or shouted sentences in general web text.

modes.description: A period ending a sentence right before an all-caps sentence starts.

card.writes: It pushes the next word to be a capital letter starting an all-caps word and suppresses code-like tokens.
card.plain: It fires in passages written in capital letters, helping the model keep going in caps.
